description: Land Acquisition - Komdawala and Madamulla, Ibbagamuwa D/S Division, Kurunegala District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels being acquired for public purposes, including lot numbers, extents, boundaries, and location details. While it mentions a government minister (S. M. Chandrasena), this is only in the context of issuing the land acquisition declaration, not about government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities. The core content is purely land-related, fitting Type 4 (Land Gazettes) for land acquisition notices.
